_meta.description: FICTIONAL seed data for OSMHelper waiting list rank/notes feature. All children, parents, emails (example.com) and phone numbers (Ofcom drama range 01632 960xxx) are invented. No real group data.
_meta.shape_notes: Mirrors what WaitingListController / MembershipDashboardController / OsmApi consume: oauth_resource.data.sections[] (section_id, section_name, section_type='waiting', group_name, terms); per list: getListOfMembers.items[] (scoutid, firstname, lastname, dob, joined), getIndividual[scoutid].data (dob, joined, firstname, lastname, customfields.customfield_123), customdata_getData[scoutid].data[] groups with identifier 'customisable_data' and columns[] (column_id, varname, label, type, value). Response envelopes are best-effort approximations of OSM; keys the code reads are exact.

field_refs.note: Varnames f_1/f_2 are example refs; column_id differs per waiting list (990001: rank 101, notes 102; 990002: rank 211, notes 212) to exercise per-list mapping. Decoy fields (f_3, f_4, f_5, cf_notes) are present to test the settings picker.

_meta.rank_ties: 990001 has ties at rank 3 and 8; 990002 has a tie at rank 4. Blank ranks are empty strings.
